summary.method: Whole Japanese/English duplicate retrieval plus English full-text ranking, followed by separately recorded model semantic review; no embedding model, translation generation or automatic publication.
summary.limitation: Ranked candidates and duplicate wording are retrieval evidence, not semantic equivalence. Absence from retrieval never proves absence from the project. Easy Chat omission is a project-level documented limitation; reusable words elsewhere are checked separately.
